releaseNotes:
Home Remote 1.3.1

- Repairs mute/unmute state handling when the TV reports volume and mute separately. Changes wait for reported TV state; uncertain commands are never repeated automatically.
- Adds the supplied genuine Netflix, YouTube and Prime Video artwork to all five themes.
- Adds a little spacing while retaining existing control sizes and safe scrolling for short windows or large text.

Install this compatible update over Home Remote to retain local pairing, saved TVs and preferences. Do not uninstall or clear app data. Each phone keeps its own pairing. TV control remains local; update checks use the existing GitHub download flow.
